title: Required.
officialText:
Approved smoke and heat vents shall be installed in the roofs of one-story buildings where required by the New
York City Fire Code. Smoke and heat vents shall be designed and installed in accordance with the New York City Fire Code.
SECTION MC 312
HEATING AND COOLING LOAD CALCULATIONS
